sobre.title: About me
sobre.paragrafo1: Hello! My name is Paulo Cesar, I'm 18 years old and I'm passionate about technology that transforms ideas into visual projects. Since high school, I studied Systems Development and found myself in the world of programming, and today I study Systems Analysis and Development at Anhanguera College.
sobre.paragrafo2: I like learning new things and being self-taught in different areas, such as learning other languages. For me, programming is much more than knowing language X or Y - it's about solving problems with the right tools.
sobre.paragrafo3: I am driven by challenges and have a special affection for everything that involves UI (user interface). Creating web applications and websites is where I feel most motivated, always seeking to combine functionality and a good experience for those who use it.

aprendendo.title: What I'm learning
aprendendo.subtitle: I'm currently building a CRM, and this project has been my main source of study on software architecture and back-end.

solid.title: SOLID
solid.text: Object-oriented design principles to write cleaner, decoupled and easy-to-maintain code, where each class has a single responsibility.

mvc.title: MVC
mvc.text: Splitting the application into Model, View and Controller, organizing business rules, the interface and the request flow.

database.title: Database manipulation
database.text: Modeling tables and relationships, SQL queries and CRUD operations to create, read, update and delete customer data.

projeto1.title: Personal Marketing
projeto1.text: Project that was part of the final project of the 3rd year of high school. A website that provides content on personal marketing, with the objective of studying employability and standing out in the job market.

projeto2.title: Clone of the official Netflix website (2024)
projeto2.text: A project I developed to challenge myself to clone a website I've always admired. I thought: why not create something similar and show that I'm capable of doing a project on the same level as Netflix?

projeto3.title: Storage and ordering system
projeto3.text: Project developed for a confectionery shop called Jojoca Doces, a system that solved a problem for the confectionery shop, which was having control over its stock when placing orders.

home.phrase: A programmer is not someone who knows programming language X or Y, a programmer is someone who knows how to learn quickly and apply their knowledge.
